name: Infinite Power cuts the owned Chromatic Shard and Melt Reality ranks' cooldowns (#9472)
contract: Infinite Power 92118 reads "Casting damaging spells now reduces your damaging spell cooldowns by
$528312s1% of their remaining cooldown." Its aura 42 triggers 503946, whose three effect-192 entries name
Timerend 801291, Chromatic Shard 801292 and Melt Reality 806335 with 10% each. 801292 and 806335 are rank 1
of their spell_ranks chains; a level-60 Chronomancer casts Chromatic Shard rank 9 567544 and Melt Reality
rank 7 572835, whose cooldowns are the ones the client shows and Spell::CheckCast enforces. Both chains
share one Category with CategoryRecoveryTime 30000 on every rank. A control Chronomancer without Infinite
Power casts the same ranks right after the talented one, so its cooldowns are at least as long; the talented
caster's owned-rank cooldowns can only fall below the control's through the proc. After both cooldowns
run, the talented caster casts Wand of Time 520175, a direct ranged-class damage spell, so at least one
proc lands on two running cooldowns of 25 s or more: 10% of each is well over 1.5 s.
